newsitem.title: USA: Norwood 97 EPS could be $0.10 below goal.
newsitem.headline: Norwood 97 EPS could be $0.10 below goal.

text.p: Norwood Promotional Products Inc said Thursday fiscal 1997 results could fall short of plan by about $0.10 a share.
Norwood said that retail sales at the Alpha division remain below plan and are slower than expected.
The company reported earnings for the second quarter ended March 1, 1997 of $0.03 a share, compared with $0.02 the previous second quarter.
When asked what the company's earnings goal was for 1997, a company spokeswoman said that the analysts' estimates for 1997 earnings are $1.30 a share.
She did not distinguish between analysts 'estimates and the company's goals.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate is $1.31 a share.
